heroTitle: Supporting the next frontier of steel reuse
heroLede: Circular Steel USA builds on UK leadership to support the growth of structural steel reuse across North America. As interest accelerates in embodied carbon reduction, Circular Steel USA provides a focused forum for practitioners, owners and policymakers seeking practical pathways to deliver reuse projects.
closingText: Together, they explore how global lessons can accelerate regional market readiness. A practical, practitioner-led forum. Circular Steel USA prioritises real-world delivery, connecting those designing, procuring and delivering projects with reuse ambitions.
